neighbours.label: the verb before a predicate of availability/accessibility (will be [made] available, [became] available)
fire: Concert tickets will be made available to fans on Friday morning.
The new firmware became available for download last week.
Recordings of the lectures were made available online.
The vaccine was made available to all adults in April.
Spare parts became available again after the strike ended.
The full report will be made available to the public.
Rooms at the lodge became available after a cancellation.
Discounts are made available to students with a valid ID.
quiet: Concert tickets will be sold to fans on Friday morning.
The new firmware fixed several bugs last week.
Recordings of the lectures were deleted by mistake.
The vaccine was tested on adults in April.
Spare parts got expensive again after the strike ended.
The full report will be finished next month.
Rooms at the lodge were painted after a cancellation.
Discounts are offered to students with a valid ID.
